description: List the workspace's price lists (Gold, Silver, dealer tiers ...), by name: each with percentOff (percent off the catalogue, 2 decimals; negative = a markup), startsAt / endsAt and active (false outside that window: the list prices nobody and its buyers pay catalogue prices), overrideCount (fixed prices it holds), assignedCount (companies and customers it prices) and channels (the sales channels it is published to, with key and priceAccess). A list prices a buyer from a fixed price per product or variant where it has one, else the catalogue price minus percentOff. Read-only; entries are in get_price_list.
name: list_price_lists
title: List price lists
